raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The modal-torch-latest AWS capacity fallback installs the same transformers git main ref as the Modal sandbox, but still provisions Python 3.10.13. transformers main now requires >=3.11.0, so [aws:prepare] fails: `Package 'transformers' requires a different Python: 3.10.13 not in '>=3.11.0'`.

#8902 bumped only the Modal sandbox. This aligns the fallback: AWS_PYTHON_VERSION 3.10.13 -> 3.12.14 (CPython the pinned uv 0.12.7 can download, verified), runtime root python310 -> python312, test assertions updated.

Validation: pytest ci/test_torch_latest.py 49 passed; yapf/flake8 clean.

Signed-off-by: Guokai Ma <guokai.ma@intel.com>

When `aws-torch-latest-full.yml` runs on its schedule, it selects `DEFAULT_TRANSFORMERS_SOURCE=git` and `DEFAULT_TRANSFORMERS_REF=main` (`.github/workflows/aws-torch-latest-full.yml:104-109,140-155`) and later executes `pip install .` (`:249-264`), but its `nvidia/cuda:12.6.3-devel-ubuntu22.04` container merely installs `/usr/bin/python3` (`:99-119`), which is Python 3.10. detail.body:
The modal-torch-latest AWS capacity fallback installs the same transformers git main ref as the Modal sandbox, but still provisions Python 3.10.13. transformers main now requires >=3.11.0, so [aws:prepare] fails: `Package 'transformers' requires a different Python: 3.10.13 not in '>=3.11.0'`.

#8902 bumped only the Modal sandbox. This aligns the fallback: AWS_PYTHON_VERSION 3.10.13 -> 3.12.14 (CPython the pinned uv 0.12.7 can download, verified), runtime root python310 -> python312, test assertions updated.

files.patch:
@@ -864,8 +864,8 @@ def test_aws_scripts_reuse_full_selection_manifest_and_two_gpu_contract():
         assert "/var/lib/devds/runs/123-1" in prepare
         assert "--gpus '\"device=0,1\"'" in prepare
         assert "uv==0.12.7" in prepare
-        assert "uv venv --python 3.10.13 --seed /workspace/python310" in prepare
-        assert "PATH=/workspace/python310/bin:" in prepare
+        assert "uv venv --python 3.12.14 --seed /workspace/python312" in prepare
+        assert "PATH=/workspace/python312/bin:" in prepare
         assert "expected exactly 2 visible GPUs" in prepare
         assert "ci/modal_diagnostics/pr8654_71_nodes.txt" not in prepare + test
         assert "tests/unit/v1" in test

@@ -106,9 +106,9 @@
 REMOTE_ROOT = "/workspace"
 REMOTE_REPOSITORY = f"{REMOTE_ROOT}/deepspeed"
 REMOTE_TRANSFORMERS = f"{REMOTE_ROOT}/transformers"
-AWS_PYTHON_VERSION = "3.10.13"
+AWS_PYTHON_VERSION = "3.12.14"
 AWS_UV_VERSION = "0.12.7"
-AWS_PYTHON_ROOT = f"{REMOTE_ROOT}/python310"
+AWS_PYTHON_ROOT = f"{REMOTE_ROOT}/python312"
 AWS_CONTAINER_PATH = f"{AWS_PYTHON_ROOT}/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
 GDS_TEST_TARGET = "tests/unit/v1/nvme/test_gds.py"
 AWS_CONFIG_ENV = "AWS_MODAL_FALLBACK_CONFIG"
